sections.title: Format selection
sections.prose: memory_face checks PCF, PFR, WINFNT, BDF, and CID in that order. The first recognized format immediately dispatches to its face constructor; the BDF path first returns a constructor error if one is found.
sections.spokenText: The first recognized format immediately dispatches to its face constructor; the BDF path first returns a constructor error if one is found.
